summary: Verified bugfix for OFF switches in Rimessaggio preventivo (PDF 'Dettaglio manutenzione motore' and UI breakdown). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass covering /api/calcola-costi for each motor flag (anodi_interni, anodi_esterni, filtro_olio, olio_piede, ingrassaggio, girante) + 2nd motor variant, generic flags (antivegetativa, lavaggio_inizio, lavaggio_fine, scafo_sporco, copertura, alaggio_varo), PDF text extraction with pymupdf confirms 'Kit anodi interni' and 'Filtro olio' NOT in motor table while 'Kit anodi esterni', 'Olio piede', 'Ingrassaggio', 'Girante' ARE present. Full cliente CRUD + PDF flow verified: toggling anodi_interni_attivo true re-adds +50 to costo_ricambi_totale and makes the row reappear in PDF; test cliente deleted. Frontend: Preventivo veloce modal opened, lunghezza=6, HP=40, verified data-testid='totale-costi' decreased after flipping switch-anodi-interni (2319→2269 €, i.e. -50), 'Kit anodi interni' row removed from data-testid='ricambi-breakdown'. Also verified switch-antivegetativa (−225), switch-lavaggio-inizio (−90) and switch-girante (−50) all reduce the total.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in pdf_builders._build_motore_table correctly filters rows by flags_1/flags_2; `girante_attivo` uses default-true semantics (`is not False`) which matches existing docs that don't carry the field — safe for backward compat.
/api/clienti PUT requires full body (not patch semantics). Not a bug but worth documenting; frontend already sends full body.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_PDF cliente created and deleted inside test_cliente_pdf_toggles; no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression test file at /app/backend/tests/test_switches_off_bugfix.py (requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env). Covers all motor/generic flags and PDF content checks via pymupdf.
rca of the issue: Pre-fix, backend already computed costs correctly when flags were false, but pdf_builders._build_motore_table unconditionally rendered rows (anodi, filtro olio, etc.) regardless of the *_attivo flags, so a switched-OFF item still showed with its unit price in the PDF, making subtotal/line sum inconsistent. Fix routes flags_1/flags_2 dicts into the row builder; UI BreakdownRow also hides zero-cost lines. Verified end-to-end.
